title: Modes file: the option chosen for each trip of one day
description: Written by the LLM (llm_stub.py stands in until then) from llm_inputs/modes_input_day_N.json (each trip's options, from make_choices.py), and read with the schedule by convert_demand.py. $defs/agent is one agent's answer, for one LLM call. llm_tasks.py and convert_demand.py also check what a schema cannot: every trip of the schedule has exactly one choice, every trip_id is in the schedule, the choice is one of the trip's options, a car or bike only where it was left, and no choice arriving after the next trip leaves when another option would not. See README.md.

day.description: The same day as the schedule.

made_by.description: Who or what wrote the file (model, prompt version).

trip_id.description: A trip from the choices file, e.g. A0001_D01_T01.

route_id.description: The jeepney line: needed with mode jeepney, and only then.

reasoning.description: Why, in a sentence. Optional, kept for reading.
